content: For 2025/2026 App Router JSON-LD: skip next-seo (built for Pages Router meta tags; App Router's native Metadata API already covers that surface). Instead render a <script type='application/ld+json'> tag directly from a Server Component (so crawlers see it without JS execution), typed at compile-time with the schema-dts npm package (pure TypeScript type defs for schema.org, zero runtime cost) to catch malformed structured data before shipping.
